ideas.title: Sift Sand for Scarabs
ideas.hook: Shovel desert sand into your sieve and shake it. Most of it is dust, but every few scoops a jewelled scarab drops out and joins your collection.
core_loop: Dig a scoop of sand from the dune
Shake the sieve to sort dust from finds
Add scarabs and relics to the museum index
Spend relic coins on bigger sieves and deeper dunes
ideas.twist: Rare scarabs are alive: they burrow back into the sand if you shake too hard, so careful sifting beats fast clicking.
retention: Weekly sandstorm event with limited scarabs
ideas.why_now: Collect / index × Ancient / pyramids is an open gap (4.28). Break / mine / dig is the fastest rising mechanic at 3.54x (Break and Steal an Egg 507.9K CCU, My Anime Mine 13.5K) and Collect / index is up 2.23x. "___ for ___" titles lead at 2.92x (Search For The Needle 16.2K).
ideas.differentiator: Desert games are about building pyramids; this one is about what is buried under them, with a sifting feel nobody uses yet.

ideas.title: Repaint Zombies for Cash
ideas.hook: Grey zombies shuffle onto your lawn. Paint them back to full colour and they wake up cured, then go to work in your shop.
core_loop: Pick a shuffling grey zombie
Paint colour onto it before it reaches your fence
Cured zombies become workers on your plot
Use their earnings on brighter paints and bigger plots
ideas.twist: The neater the paint job, the better the worker: a sloppy zombie works slowly and sometimes turns grey again.
retention: Worker roster that grows every night
Halloween horde nights with bonus pay
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Zombies is an open gap (3.51). Paint / create is up 1.91x (Paint to Get Rich 28.3K CCU, Paint a Pancake 9.3K) and Tycoon / base building is up 1.70x (Build and Kill Zombies 13.9K). "___ for ___" titles lead at 2.92x.
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games ask you to kill or survive them; here you cure them with a brush and they run your business.

ideas.title: Toss Heels for Diamonds
ideas.hook: Spin and launch a high heel as far as you can down the runway. Where it lands, a diamond pops out, and better throws reach rarer gems.
core_loop: Wind up a spin and release
Watch the heel fly and bounce
Grab the diamond where it lands
Buy fancier heels that fly further
ideas.twist: Each heel style flies differently: stilettos go straight, platforms bounce, boots spin, so players collect shoes for different lanes.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch × Fashion / beauty is the top open gap left (5.12). Hit / swing / launch is up 1.82x (+1 Stone Skipping 46.5K CCU, Cat Battles 31.9K) and Fashion / beauty is up 1.72x (Facecard: Makeup Showdown 41.4K).
ideas.differentiator: Fashion games are about outfits and judging; this is a simple throw-for-distance game with fashion as the hook.

ideas.title: Steal Outfits for Fame
ideas.hook: Run a boutique on your plot and fill its rails with outfits. Sneak into rival boutiques to grab their rarest looks before the mannequins catch you.
core_loop: Collect outfits from the fashion drop
Display them on your boutique rails for fame per second
Sneak into other plots to swipe a rare outfit
Lock your best pieces behind guards and alarms
ideas.twist: Stolen outfits only earn full fame once you restyle them, so thieves still have to dress the mannequin themselves.
ideas.why_now: Steal / raid × Fashion / beauty is an open gap (3.97). The Collect / index + Steal / raid pair holds 594.8K young CCU (Break and Steal an Egg 507.9K, Steal ASMR! 14.6K), and Fashion / beauty is up 1.72x (Facecard: Makeup Showdown 41.4K, Makeup Salon 12.5K).
ideas.differentiator: Steal games swap the same creatures; here the loot is outfits you also have to style, which draws the dress-up crowd in.

ideas.title: Tumble Rocks for Gems
ideas.hook: Drop dull rocks into your tumbler, crank it, and watch them come out shiny. Sell the polished gems at your stall.
core_loop: Pick rocks from the quarry pile
Load the tumbler and crank it
Pull out polished gems, some with rare cores
Sell them at your stall to buy bigger tumblers
ideas.twist: Cracking a rock first reveals its core, but a bad crack ruins it, so players gamble between safe polish and risky crack.
retention: Daily rare rock in the pile
Satisfying polish sound and shine as a reason to come back
ideas.why_now: Stones / rocks / ores is the top rising theme at 2.23x (+1 Stone Skipping 46.5K CCU, Lift Rock For Eggs 16.3K). Sell / run a shop is up 1.67x (Sell Fries! 87.9K, Fix My Phone! 2.4K) and Break / mine / dig is up 3.54x. New shop games use satisfying, product-first art.
ideas.differentiator: Rock games are about lifting or smashing; this is a calm ASMR shop where the rock turns into something you sell.

ideas.title: +1 Dino Stomp
ideas.hook: You hatch as a tiny dino. Every stomp adds +1 size, and bigger stomps crack through rock, trees and eventually whole hills.
core_loop: Stomp the ground to gain +1 size
Break through obstacles that block the next zone
Unlock bigger dino species with rebirths
Stomp boss boulders for rare fossils
ideas.twist: Your dino species changes how stomps work (raptors stomp fast, T-rex stomps wide), so rebirths feel like a new game.
ideas.why_now: "+1 ___" titles are up 1.58x (+1 Stone Skipping 46.5K CCU, +1 Assassin Leveling 16.0K, +1 Karate Evolution 13.5K). Dinosaurs is up 1.63x (Ride a Dino 23.4K) and Break / mine / dig is up 3.54x.
ideas.differentiator: Most +1 games train a person; here you grow a dinosaur that physically breaks the map open.

ideas.title: Sketch Powers for Heroes
ideas.hook: Draw a symbol in the air and it becomes a superpower: a zigzag throws lightning, a circle makes a shield. Then take your powers into hero battles.
core_loop: Sketch a shape with your finger or mouse
The game turns it into a power based on its shape and neatness
Fight in short hero rounds
Unlock new ink colours that add elements to your sketches
ideas.twist: Two players can draw the same shape but neater lines hit harder, so skill matters more than grinding.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Superheroes / powers is an open gap (3.71). Paint / create is up 1.91x (Paint to Get Rich 28.3K CCU, Hide In Pixels 5.4K) and Superheroes / powers is up 1.23x (Superhero Arena 14.5K). New draw games put one clear verb up front.
ideas.differentiator: Hero games give you a fixed moveset; here you invent moves by drawing them.

ideas.title: Thaw Glaciers for Pets
ideas.hook: Huge glaciers hold frozen creatures. Chip and melt the ice with fire tools to free them, then hatch them as pets that melt faster for you.
core_loop: Chip ice blocks with your pick
Use heat tools to melt down to the frozen egg
Thaw the egg and hatch a pet
Pets help melt bigger glaciers in colder zones
ideas.twist: Melting too fast with fire cracks the egg inside, so stronger tools need a steady hand.
ideas.why_now: The Break / mine / dig + Hatch / gacha pair holds 545.3K young CCU (Break and Steal an Egg 507.9K, My Anime Mine 13.5K) and Break / mine / dig is up 3.54x. Ice / fire / elements is up 1.21x (Firefighting Sim 18.5K, Melt All The Ice! 4.1K). Hub + zones maps are rising at 1.64x.
ideas.differentiator: Egg games hand you eggs; here every egg is a frozen puzzle you dig out, with fire vs ice as the core tool tension.

ideas.title: Bat Notes for Fans
ideas.hook: Music notes fly at you on the beat. Swing your bat in time to smash them into the crowd and win fans.
core_loop: Pick a song
Swing on the beat as notes fly in
Perfect hits launch notes into the stands for fans
Spend fans on new bats and harder songs
ideas.twist: Each bat type changes the rhythm (a guitar bat hits chords, a drumstick bat hits double notes), so new bats unlock new ways to play songs.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch × Music / dance is an open gap (3.74). Hit / swing / launch is up 1.82x (+1 Stone Skipping 46.5K CCU, Ragdoll Engine 14.6K) and Music / dance is up 1.38x (Piano Rhythm Tiles 8.0K, Aura Dance Battles 7.5K).
ideas.differentiator: Rhythm games use taps on tiles; here every hit is a full-body swing with a launch payoff.

ideas.title: Build a Robot Pal
ideas.hook: Build your own robot from parts, paint it, and send it to work. A better-built robot earns more and follows you around.
core_loop: Collect robot parts from the scrapyard
Snap them together and paint your robot
Send it to jobs on your plot for cash
Upgrade parts to unlock new jobs and abilities
ideas.twist: Robots you build can be copied by friends as blueprints, so good designs spread and their creator gets a cut.
retention: Showcase pad where players vote on robots
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Robots / mechs is an open gap (3.73). Paint / create is up 1.91x (Paint to Get Rich 28.3K CCU) and Tycoon / base building is up 1.70x (Bunker vs Verity 39.2K). Robots / mechs is up 1.39x and "Build a ___" titles are up 1.18x (Build the Pyramid! 13.5K).
ideas.differentiator: Robot games are about fighting mechs; this is a cute build-and-paint companion that earns for you.
